title: fix(objectql)!: the one-hop read through a reference never reads a stored-metadata-body table; the lint refuses it
body:
Fixes #24316

Clause-②: no (narrowing) (owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before the queue)

⚠️ **Security card.** This body keeps to the card's disclosure line: category and position only. It carries no request, field path or value. Tests use synthetic placeholders only.

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/objectql` — the shared one-hop loader (`resolveOneHopRelated`).** A hop whose target is a stored-metadata-body table (`isStoredMetadataBodyObject`, reused from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`) is no longer read, under either authority. The binding is `unreadable`, the shape an unreadable related record already gets. A formula field reads `null` with its reason. A validation rule has no verdict, so the write is refused. Neither answer says anything about the row. One guard covers every exit that reaches the loader: a read of the carrying object (REST, and a hook body's `ctx.api` read), `findOne`, a write's response, `serveFormulaField` (the seam `ctx.title()` reads through), and the validation-rule path, which reads its hop as SYSTEM.
- **`@objectstack/lint` — the field-formula pass and hydrated validation conditions.** A one-hop read through a reference into a family table is an error, with a prescription (read stored metadata through the metadata API, where the body is projected). `os validate`, `os build` and the object save door run the same pass, so the author learns it at save time instead of from a `null`.
- **The family's enumeration pin** (`stored-metadata-body-family.pin.test.ts`) gains three rows: the formula hop's exits, the validation-rule hop, and the author-time refusal. Each row names its owning pin. 23 → 26 rows.
- Not done: no second projection, no `packages/spec` edit, no new error code, and no change to the doors' projection or the reader-context seam.

## Reach, measured before the fix (live backend, showcase app, `--fresh`)

The setup used a synthetic placeholder credential in a stored datasource body, and a carrier object with a reference into the family plus formulas through it.

| Reader | Family's own door | Through the hop (before) | Through the hop (after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| administrator, session | redacted body, keyed hash | **yes**, 1/1 rows: placeholder and unkeyed hash served | no (engine pin) |
| administrator, API key | redacted, keyed | **yes**, 1/1 | no (engine pin) |
| member granted read on the family table, session | redacted, keyed | **yes**, 1/1 | no (engine pin) |
| same member, API key | redacted, keyed | **yes**, 1/1 | no (engine pin) |
| member, no grant on the family table (default), session and API key | refused (`PERMISSION_DENIED`) | no, 0/1 (formulas `null`) | no |

- **Validation-rule hop (SYSTEM authority), before:** an administrator received the rule's own verdict over the unprojected body, which is a one-bit oracle per write. A member with no grant got the unevaluable refusal. After: no verdict for any caller (engine pin).
- **Master-detail `parent` root:** measured with no verdict served. The write was refused as unbound, so it is out of this change.

| Producer door | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| metadata save door (object type) | **accepted** (1/1 objects with formula hops; 1/1 with a rule hop) | **refused** at author-time validation, 2/2 objects (each hop named) |
| `os validate` / `os build` (`validateStackExpressions`) | accepted (the lint pin goes red when its refusal is ablated) | refused (lint pin) |
| package install | NOT MEASURED: no install of a package carrying such an object was driven | — |

## Verification (head `7946ad1a2`, after merging `origin/main`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 440 files / 8290 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 145 / 6864 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 244 passed, 3 skipped / 20641 passed, 19 skipped.
- `typecheck` for objectql, lint and metadata-protocol: exit 0 each, re-run after the merge and a rebuild of their dependency closure.
- After the merge, the targeted suites were re-run: 35, 443 and 9 tests passed.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, no paths): 71 commands, all exit 0 on `7946ad1a2`. `--ran` reconciliation: 71 derived, 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero).
- On the first run, two gates refused because the clone was shallow. After deepening, both passed (exit 0).
- **Ablation 1 (engine guard disabled):** ran with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which confirmed the mutation landed. The engine pin went 10/10 red. The tool restored the file to the HEAD blob, with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablation 2 (lint refusal disabled):** the lint pin went 5 red and 1 green. The green case is the control: a hop into an ordinary object and a bare id read. The file was restored to the HEAD blob.
- **Pin sweep:** no other test declares a reference into the family. The family pin's row count is the only pin that changed meaning, and it is load-bearing (23 → 26).
- The two existing lint pins that moved are adjusted, not weakened:
  - the #5017 receiver meta-test excuses the new Map/Set locals;
  - the master-detail carrier refusal still comes from its own pass, because the new index is read lazily.

## Acceptance notes

- The runtime answer reuses the `unreadable` binding, so a formula's fault text reads "that read failed". The authored refusal with its prescription is the lint's, at save.
